Needs changes before merge: one missing line in the body (a process-file change). No code problems found.

What looks good:
- The acknowledgment is self-validating: `stock_source::incoming_stock_source` re-reads the mark, the model fingerprint and an independent stock print, so a stale or moved source cannot keep it alive (`crates/app/src/stock_source.rs`).
- `SetStockSourceOnly::with_inherited_deficits` validates at construction: needs `on`, needs a from-model stock with a source model and geometry, and refuses a stock with no geometry to acknowledge (`crates/app/src/commands/stock_source_only.rs`).
- The session-only acknowledgment is dropped at project load in the same `check_and_apply` arm that re-reads the mark (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`), and the pinning test proves a reopened project blocks again.
- The walk now takes its steps from the program's own ops when nothing is planned, so a probe-only program is judged on the setup it runs in rather than the first setup's stock (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs`, `step_setups`). A program with a torch or wire, or an undercut pass, is refused the note and keeps the full gate, which is the conservative reading.
- The 16 pinning tests (`crates/app/tests/keep_law/incoming_stock_deficits.rs`) cover both the acknowledgment and its refusals: cut-into still blocks, probe-in-another-setup still blocks, clean stock beside an idle deficient setup posts, a probe-only program across the wrong setup refuses, and the undercut keeps the full gate.

Results merged with main (local, Linux; trial merge with current main 78199de0e - clean, `mergeable: MERGEABLE`):
- Build of `camcraft-app` (test binaries): passed, exit 0.
- `keep_law` (incl. `incoming_stock_deficits`): 47 passed, 0 failed (the 16 new tests pass: 16/16).
- `posting`: 17 passed, 0 failed (merged tree).
- `camcraft-app` lib unit tests for the touched module: 2 passed, 0 failed (`stock_sim::incoming::tests::unchanged_deficits_do_not_hide_fresh_or_deepened_gouges`, `a_different_lattice_keeps_the_full_verdict`).
- `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: NOT RUN - the host is overloaded and the shared cap of one review build is in effect while the kernel gate and a runner job are active. Re-run before merging.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): NOT RUN - same reason. Note the PR body says the light lane belongs to the independent upstream review; it is not recorded here as a pass.

Targeted tests (step 5):
- Example catalog: not run - no post or toolpath change (this is a stock-sim/verification-gate change, not a post engine or toolpath change).
- Light lane: not run (see above). A red light lane would be a note, not a blocker; it is absent here, and the author's body defers it to the upstream review.
- P1 targeted heavy step: not owed - this is P3 (posting safety check), not P1, and the author's body does not claim a heavy step.

Requested before merge:
1. The delta commit 3c4e3b7b changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (line 119: the `set_raw_stock_only` row gains `report_inherited_deficits`) - a process file - and the PR body has no `Process change: yes` line. Add the line (the merging session will bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; do not edit that file in this PR). One line in the body, no code change.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs`, `cuts_nothing_across_setups`: the not-judged refusal line appends "the operation checks do not verify the stock under probes or torches across this setup change" for any empty plan across setups. A waterjet-only program across setups is refused through this same arm, but the appended clause names probes/torches rather than the waterjet (which is what actually skipped the plan). The post is still refused either way, so this is wording, not a wrong verdict - worth a sentence in the PR notes if you want the line precise.
- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` documents the new parameter but the "124 tools" count is unchanged (the tool was extended, not added), which matches the live list. No action needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Verdict: needs changes before merge (not merge-ready).** The code is clean and well-tested, but the PR cannot be merged as-is: it carries a stale, fork-synced snapshot of the process files and conflicts with current `main` in 76 files, several of them the very files this PR touches.

### What looks good
- The fix does what the issue asks: an optional, session-only acknowledgment reports unchanged incoming-stock deficits as a located note instead of failing posting, while a fresh or deepened deficit still blocks (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_incoming.rs:11`, `:30`, `:104`).
- The acknowledgement is not saved to the project file (`crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:836` loads it as `incoming_stock_print: None`), so it resets when the project is opened — the designed behaviour.
- The MCP exposure is honest: the schema adds `report_inherited_deficits` (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:348`), the handler defaults it to `false` (`:355`, `:359`), and the reply carries the key only when the caller provided it (`:363-365`). The doc rows (`docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:48`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:118`) match the schema.
- Tests live in the existing `keep_law` directory suite (`crates/app/tests/keep_law/incoming_stock_deficits.rs`), not a new top-level test binary; no snapshot PNG or golden changes; `Process change: yes` is in the body; no `PROCESS_VERSION` edit by the PR's own code changes.
- The empty commit `c2e446a73` is tree-identical to `3c4e3b7b8` (same tree `2fa7ace3...`), so the re-check is not smuggling code — it is a legitimate new head.
- Provenance line present on the new module (`stock_sim_incoming.rs:1-4`).

### Results (merged with current main — local build, not built on the runner; fork PR from a non-collaborator, no `pr-test.yml` run)
PR head `c2e446a73`, worktree `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4066-review`, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 314 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test keep_law` (incl. the 16 pinning tests in `incoming_stock_deficits`) | 47 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` | 43 passed, 4 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_setup` | 9 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stock_source_verdict` | 22 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test edge_work` / `adaptive` | 1 passed each |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, 0 warnings |

No failures; no exact-failure text to quote.

### Targeted tests (step 5)
- This PR changes posting (an example-catalog-class change): the catalog suites ran above.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): green — 6 steps, 0 failed, wall 6.0 min (`motion light: lib` 286 s, `adaptive_troch_island` 40 s, `adaptive_troch_neck` 17 s, `adaptive_troch_parallel` 11 s, `app light: pocket_pass_start` 2 s, `light build` 3 s).
- The light lane is not required for this P3 PR to be merge-ready, but it is a green required check at review — recorded as requested.
- No heavy lane: P3 PR under the safety floor gets no targeted heavy step.

### Requested before merge
1. **Re-merge with current `main`.** A trial merge (`git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main`) reports ~76 conflicted files, including files this PR touches: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (main `164`, PR `154`), `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`, `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`, and `crates/app/src/mcp/{job.rs,listen.rs,mod.rs,tool_edit.rs,tools.rs}` — plus 60+ others (UI, geometry, motion, assets, golden, docs). The author's note that "the trial merge is clean" was accurate for `3c4e3b7b8` at the time of the earlier review, but `main` has moved well beyond it and the merge is no longer clean. Merge `origin/main` into the branch (no force-push), resolve the conflicts, re-gate, and re-push.
2. **Re-sync the process files.** The PR carries a fork-synced snapshot from v0.26.0 (Nov 25): `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` reads `154` while upstream is at `164`, and the PR diff shows the fork's sync commit changed it `149 → 154`. A fork that lands a `PROCESS_VERSION` lower than upstream regresses its process version. Re-run `fork-sync` (pull the process files from current upstream) and land the synced copy with the re-merge, or the author's fork-sync will drop process changes that landed upstream since Nov 25.
3. **(Optional) MCP parity test** for the new `report_inherited_deficits` parameter: the command-level tests in `keep_law` pin the behaviour, but `crates/app/tests/mcp_setup.rs` has no parity test for the new optional parameter. Consider a one-line call with `report_inherited_deficits: true` and verify the reply carries the key.
4. **(Optional) File length:** `crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs` grows `383 → 418` lines (over the 400-line shape rule). A split is not blocking for a small PR, but the next growth should split along a domain seam.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The empty commit `c2e446a73` is honest — identical tree to `3c4e3b7b8`, honest subject. The `Process change: yes` line is in the body, and no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` edit by the PR's own commits.
- The PR body cites `3c4e3b7b8`'s quick gate (353 of 354 steps, one golden-comparison failure that passed after the CRLF working copy was restored). That was honest; I re-ran the suites at the new head and they pass with no failures.
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` is 492 lines — pre-existing, not grown by this PR (a note only).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
